design_gotchas.title: High 4 mA/ch Quiescent Current Causes 38°C–48°C Self-Heating in SOIC-8 at ±15 V
design_gotchas.detail: At ±15 V (30 V total), dual-channel quiescent current (8 mA typ / 10 mA max total) dissipates 240 mW–300 mW at idle. With RθJA = 160 °C/W in SOIC-8, the die already runs 38°C–48°C above ambient before driving 600 Ω loads; check thermal margin closely when upgrading from TL072IDR (1.4 mA/ch).

design_gotchas.title: Zero Overvoltage Headroom Above ±18 V (36 V Abs Max = 36 V Recommended Max)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike TL072IDR (42 V abs max), OPA2134UA lists 36 V (±18 V) as both its recommended maximum and absolute maximum supply rating. Unregulated transformer ripple or power-rail transients exceeding ±18 V will violate absolute maximum ratings.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Rail-to-Rail Input Range Requires 2.5 V Bottom / 3.5 V Top Headroom
design_gotchas.detail: Guaranteed common-mode input range is (V-) + 2.5 V to (V+) - 3.5 V, making OPA2134UA impractical on 5 V single-supply rails (0 V guaranteed CM window) and incompatible with low-voltage RRIO sockets like MC33202DR2G or TLV9002IDR.

design_gotchas.title: MSL-3 Moisture Sensitivity (168 hr Floor Life) and 75-Unit Tube Packaging
design_gotchas.detail: OPA2134UA is rated Level-3-260C-168 HR (requires baking before reflow if exposed >168 hours) and ships in 75-unit tubes; order OPA2134UA/2K5 for 2500-piece tape-and-reel production.

typical_use_cases: Audiophile preamplifiers, studio mixing consoles, and DAC I/V output stages (0.00008% THD+N)
Low-noise (8 nV/√Hz) split-supply (±15 V) drop-in audio upgrade for TL072IDR
High-headroom 600 Ω and 2 kΩ balanced audio line drivers and headphone amps
Phase-inversion-free active crossovers, RIAA equalizers, and low-distortion filters
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments OPA2134UA is a flagship SoundPlus dual FET-input audio operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating from ±2.5 V to ±18 V (5 V to 36 V) across -40°C to +85°C. Pin-compatible with TL072IDR in SOIC-8, it delivers ultra-low 0.00008% THD+N, 8 nV/√Hz voltage noise, 5 pA input bias, 8 MHz GBWP, 20 V/µs slew rate, and phase-inversion immunity. Designers upgrading from TL072IDR must budget for its 4 mA/ch quiescent current (240 mW idle dissipation at ±15 V in 160 °C/W SOIC-8) and strict 36 V absolute maximum supply limit.
